Hi Samantha / Devon,

Thanks again for agreeing to the week-long executive workshop in September. To make scheduling easier across your EU leadership and our US delivery team, I've proposed three UTC "lanes" that should give us clear daily windows for workshops and executive sessions:

- Lane A: 08:00–11:00 UTC (convenient for APAC and early EU attendees)
- Lane B: 12:00–15:00 UTC (midday Europe / afternoon US East overlap)
- Lane C: 16:00–19:00 UTC (late EU / early US West)

I've attached a draft agenda and a venue access checklist (see attachments). Can you confirm which lane your execs prefer for the core 3 days (Sept 14–16)? We'll place tentative calendar holds for the entire team once we lock the lane to avoid double-booking.

A couple quick asks:
- Please loop in your AV lead if there are site bandwidth or streaming constraints.
- If procurement needs a PO or preliminary SOW to approve holds, copy them on replies.

Proposed initial calendar holds: 3 x 3-hour blocks per day (core workshop 09:00 local lead time) — we'll make them optional for observers to reduce clutter.

Attaching: workshop-agenda-draft.pdf, venue-access-checklist.xlsx

Best,
